instruction: Open 'Public Lecture Teaching Plan.docx' on the Desktop and change the lesson duration from 60 minutes to 90 minutes.

parameters.window_name: Public Lecture Teaching Plan.docx - LibreOffice Writer

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Answer.docx and saw format (Grammar test 1: bbbad). Spent 30 turns navigating File>Open dialogs to read Grammar test 1 and Grammar test 2 docx files, but ran out of turns before writing any answers back to Answer.docx.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open files in LibreOffice Writer, use File>Open dialog, navigate to Desktop folder, scroll through documents, read document content, switch between windows
metadata.failure_analysis: Model exhausted all 30 turns on file navigation and reading without ever editing Answer.docx. The multi-file reading + answer determination + writing workflow was too complex for the turn budget.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests model's ability to open a docx file and make a simple text edit (find and replace a number), a simpler sub-task than the original multi-file answer writing
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening Public Lecture Teaching Plan.docx and changing '60 minutes' to '90 minutes' in the Duration line. Getter reads the docx and finds the line starting with 'Duration:'. Metric checks exact match. [Fixed: replaced truncated 8-char MD5 suffix with correct 32-char MD5 hash in getter and metric function names]
fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced truncated 8-char MD5 suffix 'f06c8781' with correct 32-char MD5 hash '31146efdc87a4defa3f97309b7095c90' (computed from '1f18aa87-af6f-41ef-9853-cdb8f32ebdea|2') in getter function name, metric function name, evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the docx file from the right path and finds the paragraph starting with 'Duration:' prefix, which is the right line to check for the duration change
Metric correctly receives the rules dict directly (expected.type='rule') and accesses expected.get('expected_text') — proper parameter handling per framework convention
Case-insensitive comparison is appropriate and robust for text matching
Postconfig correctly activates the Writer window and saves with Ctrl+S before reading, ensuring the getter reads the latest file state
Expected value 'Duration: 90 minutes' is semantically correct for verifying the instruction to change from 60 to 90 minutes
Complete coverage: the single requirement (change duration from 60 to 90 minutes) is fully verified by checking the Duration line content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The exact format of the Duration line in the original document is assumed to be 'Duration: 60 minutes'. If the original format differs (e.g., extra spaces, different capitalization in the prefix), the startswith check might not match. Consider verifying against the actual document content.
Minor: If the document has multiple paragraphs starting with 'Duration:', only the first one is checked. This is unlikely to be an issue for this specific document but worth noting.
